See attached sample SKU reconciliation CSV and a short notes doc. Key operational notes:

1) SKU fidelity: make sure each internal SKU includes a stable external label (we use internal_sku_id, description, gcp_offer_sku_id). The mapping file I've attached follows that schema.
2) Aggregation window: Blue Harbor should confirm whether they want daily or monthly aggregation exported to their SFTP. GCP exports are daily by default; we can roll them up before ingestion if they prefer monthly.
3) Reseller path: if CloudBridge is handling invoicing markup, set the private offer to bill to reseller and include reseller_id in the mapping. This avoids double-charging on GCP.
